title: Balanced Advantage Fund: charges
text: The Balanced Advantage Fund has an expense ratio of 1.1 percent a year for the regular plan. An exit load of 1 percent applies to units redeemed within one year of allotment.
must_include: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks; read all scheme-related documents carefully.

title: Equity funds: returns
text: Returns on equity funds are not assured and depend on market performance. Past performance does not indicate future returns.
must_include: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks; read all scheme-related documents carefully.

title: Systematic investment plan (SIP)
text: A systematic investment plan invests a fixed amount every month on a chosen date. The minimum SIP amount is 500 rupees, and a SIP can be paused for up to three months from the app.
must_include: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks; read all scheme-related documents carefully.

title: Fixed deposit: premature withdrawal
text: A fixed deposit can be withdrawn before maturity with a penalty of 1 percent on the applicable interest rate. Deposits up to 5 lakh rupees per depositor are insured by DICGC.
